# GitHub Copilot Repository Instructions

Use [`../AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) as the canonical repository operating contract. Do not create a competing set of architectural or workflow rules here.

Before substantial custom implementation, preserve the solved-system-first gate. For fast-moving frameworks, SDKs, engines, stores, AI tooling, deployment systems, monetisation systems and platform requirements, verify current official documentation rather than relying on remembered APIs.

Behaviour-changing work requires fresh execution evidence. Code inspection alone is not proof that gameplay works. Preserve provenance/licensing records for third-party and generated assets.

Use the relevant schemas, experiment contracts, workflows and registry entries as source of truth. See [`../docs/AI-AGENT-CONFIG.md`](../docs/AI-AGENT-CONFIG.md) for provider-adapter policy.
